gloss: lecture notes; record of a lecture; transcript

definitions.gloss: written record of a lecture; lecture notes
definitions.explanation: A written or printed record of the content of a lecture or course, whether taken down by a student or published. Often compiled into booklets or course materials.

examples.japanese: {講義録|こうぎろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
⟦{欠席|けっせき}した→欠席する：22283_kessekisuru⟧⟦{学生|がくせい}→学生：00610_gakusei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{講義録|こうぎろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{渡|わた}した→渡す：02442_watasu⟧。
examples.english: I gave the lecture notes to the student who was absent.

notes:
Refers to the record itself, which may be handwritten notes, a transcript, or a published volume.
